author: Karel Čapek
text: Umění, pane, není věc zobáku, nýbrž věc srdce a dar boží.
original: Umění, pane, není věc zobáku, nýbrž věc srdce a dar boží.
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Jan Neruda
text: Srdce to lidské — ach bože, přebože — za zlobu móže snad, za lásku nemóže!
original: Srdce to lidské — ach bože, přebože — za zlobu móže snad, za lásku nemóže!
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Albert Einstein
text: Věřím, že láska je lepší učitel než pocit povinnosti – alespoň pro mě.
original: I firmly believe that love [of a subject or hobby] is a better teacher than a sense of duty—at least for me.
source: Draft letter to Philipp Frank (1940), Einstein Archives 71-191, quoted in The Ultimate Quotable Einstein p.17
context: love of subject, not romantic love; paraphrased translation
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Carl Gustav Jung
text: Kde vládne láska, není vůle k moci; kde převládá moc, láska chybí.
original: Where love reigns, there is no will to power; and where the will to power is paramount, love is lacking.
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Charlie Chaplin
text: V srdcích máte lásku k lidstvu!
original: You have the love of humanity in your hearts!
context: dialogue of fictional character played by Chaplin
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Audrey Hepburnová
text: Narodila jsem se s nesmírnou potřebou náklonnosti a touhou ji dávat.
original: I myself was born with an enormous need for affection and a terrible need to give it.
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Matka Tereza
original: Love begins at home, and destruction and hatred begin at home also.
source: Mother Teresa official quotes, family life
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation

author: Mahátma Gándhí
text: Kde je láska, tam je život; nenávist vede ke zkáze.
original: Where there is Love, there is Life; hatred leads to destruction.
translation: Original Czech or working Czech translation
